title: To Pursue a Woman with Honor: Why Courtship Still Matters
author: Martin, Chris
source: The Ways of a Gentleman, February 19, 2026
summary: Martin recovers the virtue of traditional courtship in modern context, arguing that courtship was a structured process where men made intentions clear and families remained aware of developing relationships. He contends that honesty about marriage intentions and public accountability would bring tremendous value to young men and women navigating romance today.
points: Courtship involved structured pursuit with clear intentions of marriage, not casual dating.
Public courtship with family awareness provided accountability and protected intimacy.
Modern men can still pursue women with marriage intentions rather than casual relationships.
Recovering courtship principles would provide value amid hook-up culture.
quotes: The traditional courtship of decades past might seem like a foreign concept when compared to the modern dating scene. It was a rather structured process where a man made his intentions known early.

If he pursued a woman, it was understood that he was evaluating her for marriage, and she was most likely doing the same thing. Knowing those intentions removed a lot of the uncertainty that defines modern dating.
Courtship was also something that was done in public. Families were aware that it was taking place and it was well known in a community.

A man today can still pursue a woman with the intention of finding a wife. In fact, many women will appreciate honesty when a man states these intentions instead of seeking a purely physical relationship or testing the waters in a hook up culture.” Archived from The Ways of a Gentleman on May 2, 2026 by Tim.
